Edit a value here and the pytest decides whether the mock is still the server; never hand-copy these strings into the spec. Deck W paints its ground on a
wrapper (the .slide is transparent); deck I carries it as an inline style on the .slide (unpinned graph deck). On both a bare
would be a transparent root, so the e2e root-background check tells the deck's frame from the fallback.
